flower_note: J_flower1 and eight J_Petal/End bones are integral to SK_Abomination_02. No separate Boss flower mesh was found by exact directory/name search. Decorative flower matches are listed as unconfirmed name-only candidates.
material_unresolved: Cooked Master_ModelMaterial names the final EmissiveColor expression Multiply_12, but that expression and connecting math nodes are not retained as exports. The exact packed channel-to-emission routing is not proven from these metadata.
Do not treat all nonblack _E pixels or the whole body as emissive based on the filename.

geometry_bounds.axes: UE source coordinates in cm: X,Y horizontal; Z vertical. No Blueprint placement or gameplay root motion is applied.
geometry_bounds.method: Decode glTF positions back to UE (X,Z,Y)*100. Compute raw reference world TRS and inverse bind. Apply CUE4Parse-decoded sparse idle channels with shortest-path quaternion SLERP; absent channels retain raw rest. Linear blend skinning (all source weights rigid here).

idle_full_clip_sampled_envelope.sampling_note: Sampled union, not an analytical guarantee over continuous time. Includes every source frame, 7 subframes per interval, and end hold.

sequence.name: jungleAbomination_idle
sequence.time_rule: CUE4Parse source-frame coordinate = seconds * FramesPerSecond; key arrays sampled without constructing a bbmodel clip.

conditional_scaling.assumption: If the other session sets 200 cm Mossy body to 2.4 blocks, 1 cm = .012 blocks. Final shared calibration remains pending.

limitations: These are source-geometry envelopes, not a claim about visible in-game standing height.
Raw rest includes long appendages and unfolded flower geometry.
No real gameplay or final display_mob validation is claimed.
